_about: S1 THE GROUND BITE v1 (pool lane S1, STAGED DARK, UNPROVEN IN UNITY). ONE authoring file read by GroundBite.cs; apply_s1.py also compiles `spots` into zones.json spots (ground_bite_<i>) so zone_shot rows can name them. enabled false = nothing runs. Needs burrow_croc.json enabled (the biter is the burrow croc fighter) and surprise_director.json enabled (or the -s1 proof arg). All numbers and names below; no literals in the C#.

zone._about: the visit box in world metres (Sobek lane, in front of the boss ring which starts at z about 45.7). Entering it (from outside) starts a visit: SurpriseGate.Reset, new seeded spot pick and chance roll. zoneKey is the SurpriseGate zone name.

roll._about: per visit: chance (0..1) that an ambush is armed at all, armDelayS after entering before it can fire, maxPerRun caps ambushes in one game run (0 = no cap), spotsSalt keys the seeded stream.

spotNote: S1 GROUNDBITE candidate ambush spot (lane x +-1.2, z 38.6..44.4: before the boss ring z 45.7, boss stand 0/53)

croc._about: the biter is the existing burrow croc fighter (spawn id from burrow_croc.json / zones.json). It must be alive and not engaged, else the ambush does not fire (and the gate is not claimed). Placed at the spot + (rightM, forwardM) in Joan's own frame at the moment of the grab (negative rightM = her shield side, the left arm).

trigger._about: Joan within radiusM (flat) of the spot AND armed, not inside a dodge i-frame window (a well-timed roll over the spot beats it for now: the spot stays armed).

tell._about: BEFORE: faint ripple ring + a few dust puffs at the spot every intervalS (+- jitterFrac) once Joan is within radiusM of it. Existing BurrowCrocFx particle / decal assets. (No reed prop exists: the reed twitch is listed as missing.)

bite._about: the clamp: Joan is held (DuelFighter.Stagger for holdS, clip holdClip) while the croc is forced up (BurrowCroc.forceUp) with an eruption burst + double ring. The held-down croc brain is switched off for the window so it cannot add its own bites. missDamage x the croc's DamageScaleNow is taken on a miss (nonLethal keeps 1 hp, like the belly bite). ticksPerSecond = the duel tick rate.

wrench._about: ONE beat: press ANY of these actions (existing InputMap ids; fallbackKeys = the legacy KeyCode when no rebind, same order) after graceS and before holdS ends to wrench free. strike = attack, dodge = roll key.

after._about: what the croc does once Joan is free (or after the miss): mode fight = it stays up and fights (the burrow croc: 96 hp, claws only), dive = it sinks (diveDelayS = burrowS) then ZoneRuntime.ForceDisengage puts it home and burrowed again, random = dive with probability diveChance (seeded).

cues._about: placeholders from the existing cues.json cue names (CueBus.Play); empty = silent. Real jaw snap / sand burst / croc hiss are missing audio.

proof._about: harness only (compiled out with FRANKEN_NO_HARNESS). Arg `-s1:<n><flags>`: n = spot index forced (forces the gate open, ignores chance / armDelay / maxPerRun / seed), flags: w = auto wrench press at autoWrenchS (free path; without w the miss path runs), d = croc dives after, f = croc fights after (neither = the data mode). `-s1:off` = master off. holdS replaces bite.holdS so stills can catch the clamp. The camera / walk is the proof recipe in READY.md.
